$comment: Global role -> model routing. Format is OpenCode 'provider/model'; the Splice backend strips the 'amazon-bedrock/' prefix (bedrockModelId() in packages/backend/src/models.ts). Env overrides per role: MODEL_<ROLE_UPPER> (e.g. MODEL_SPEC_WRITER). OPENCODE_MODEL remains the legacy override for the default role. Splice roles (spec_writer, engine_writer, ui_synthesizer, refusal_fallback) MUST be Claude models: llm.ts uses the Anthropic Messages API on Bedrock with structured outputs. Verify each ID is enabled in the Bedrock console for your AWS_REGION.

role_notes.decomp_worker: Python OpenCode/Ghidra worker (launch.py). Any OpenCode-supported model.
role_notes.spec_writer: Splice Step 2: requirements + acceptance tests + oracle adapter. Claude only.
role_notes.engine_writer: Splice Step 3a: engine implementation from the spec. Claude only.
role_notes.ui_synthesizer: Splice Step 3b: UI synthesis + refine/auto-fix. Claude only.
role_notes.refusal_fallback: Retried once when a Splice role's model returns stop_reason 'refusal' (Bedrock has no server-side fallbacks). Claude only.

options.label: Qwen3 Coder 480B (A35B)
options.note: Coding model for OpenCode roles such as decomp_worker. Not usable by Splice's llm.ts (Anthropic Messages API only). Confirm the exact ID in the Bedrock console.
